environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a rule group reference statement using the vendor-managed rule group 'aws:managed:aws:sql-database' (AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet) with override action set to none (meaning individual rule actions apply - all rules in COUNT mode were switched to BLOCK via rule action override). Additionally, a custom rule with priority 1 uses a RegexPatternSet matching common SQL injection patterns in query string parameters with field-to-match set to 'QueryString' and text transformation 'URL_DECODE' followed by 'LOWERCASE'. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the managed rule group inspects both body and query string fields with sensitivity level HIGH.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with HTTPS listener, WAFv2 WebACL association
config.database: PostgreSQL 14, service role has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on public schema
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
